posts.title: Diabetes: The Silent Disease
posts.excerpt: Diabetes mellitus, commonly known as diabetes, is one of the most widespread and most underestimated chronic conditions in the Czech Republic — affecting an estimated 10% of the population. The good news is that thanks to modern treatments, including GLP-1 receptor agonists and SGLT2 inhibitors, diabetes is more manageable today than ever before.
